name: Sheet music
summary: Music stand holding a sheet with five-line staves, notes and a treble clef; for rehearsal and orchestra scenes.

params.name: x
params.note: centre x of the stand foot

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the stand's foot rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: room scale; 1 m is about 560 px, so at s = 1 the stand and sheet are about 1.3 m (730 px) tall

params.name: anim
params.note: wobble = the sheet sways very slightly on the stand
